compiled_state.title: Add BRIDGE_ENV_ID fail-fast precondition step to outbound-bridge.yml and inbound-bridge.yml
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: both outbound-bridge.yml and inbound-bridge.yml fail at the precondition step with a non-zero exit and a diagnostic message when BRIDGE_ENV_ID is empty
- DD3: the BRIDGE_ENV_ID repo variable is set to a non-empty UUID and visible in gh variable list (documentation + provisioning step; the actual gh variable set is a one-time operational step documented here)

## What
Add a \"Validate BRIDGE_ENV_ID\" step to both workflow YAML files, modeled exactly on the existing \"Validate ACLI version before download\" step pattern (outbound-bridge.yml lines 69-77 area).

## Implementation

In .github/workflows/outbound-bridge.yml, add a new step BEFORE the \"Mount tickets branch\" step:

      - name: Validate BRIDGE_ENV_ID
        run: |
          BRIDGE_ENV_ID=\"${{ vars.BRIDGE_ENV_ID }}\"
          if [ -z \"$BRIDGE_ENV_ID\" ]; then
            echo \"ERROR: BRIDGE_ENV_ID is unset or empty — cannot run outbound bridge.\"
            echo \"       Set the BRIDGE_ENV_ID repository variable to a non-empty UUID:\"
            echo \"         gh variable set BRIDGE_ENV_ID --body '$(uuidgen || python3 -c \\\"import uuid; print(uuid.uuid4())\\\")'\"
            exit 1
          fi

Apply the same step to .github/workflows/inbound-bridge.yml at the same position (before ticket branch worktree mount step).

## Operational note (for repo admin, not automated)
To provision the BRIDGE_ENV_ID repo variable, run once:
  gh variable set BRIDGE_ENV_ID --body \"$(python3 -c 'import uuid; print(uuid.uuid4())')\"

## Files to modify
- .github/workflows/outbound-bridge.yml
- .github/workflows/inbound-bridge.yml

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] outbound-bridge.yml contains BRIDGE_ENV_ID precondition step
  Verify: grep -q \"Validate BRIDGE_ENV_ID\" .github/workflows/outbound-bridge.yml
- [ ] inbound-bridge.yml contains BRIDGE_ENV_ID precondition step
  Verify: grep -q \"Validate BRIDGE_ENV_ID\" .github/workflows/inbound-bridge.yml
- [ ] outbound-bridge.yml precondition step exits 1 when BRIDGE_ENV_ID is empty (structural grep check)
  Verify: grep -A5 \"Validate BRIDGE_ENV_ID\" .github/workflows/outbound-bridge.yml | grep -q \"exit 1\"
- [ ] inbound-bridge.yml precondition step exits 1 when BRIDGE_ENV_ID is empty (structural grep check)
  Verify: grep -A5 \"Validate BRIDGE_ENV_ID\" .github/workflows/inbound-bridge.yml | grep -q \"exit 1\"
- [ ] Both workflow files are valid YAML
  Verify: python3 -c \"import yaml, sys; [yaml.safe_load(open(f)) for f in ['.github/workflows/outbound-bridge.yml', '.github/workflows/inbound-bridge.yml']]; print('YAML valid')\"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
